assertions.name: normalisation_factor_matches_h3
assertions.source: Checks if the Kashiwara-crystal projection yields the 1/dim H_3 = 1/6 factor rather than the 1/14 Wedderburn-block-weighted form.

description: Session B probe: attempts to derive the 1/dim H_3 = 1/6 factor as the per-cell normalisation under the half-symmetric projection Π_HS using a Kashiwara-crystal projection.
caveats: The probe hits the pre-stated failure signature: the factor comes out as a Wedderburn-weighted form (1/14 at q=1 for H_4 self-conjugate, or 1/6 for H_3, but tied to the Wedderburn sums Σ d²). This implies the (α_em/π)/dim H_3 factor is correct numerically but NOT derived from a fundamental per-cell Yekutieli structure. Session B result is NEGATIVE.
